# The programs the scanner may start in a fork-path analysis, at any depth: its own, the Sonar
# engine's and the analyzers'. scripts/check-launches.ts fails the fixtures' analyses when it starts
# anything else.
#
# One absolute path per line. * stands for any characters but /, ** for any characters, and ${NAME}
# for an environment variable of the checking job, which runs on the same kind of runner.

# The scanner
${RUNNER_TEMP}/sonar-scanner-*/scanner/sonar-scanner-*/bin/sonar-scanner
/usr/bin/sh
/usr/bin/dirname
/usr/bin/basename
${RUNNER_TEMP}/sonar-scanner-*/scanner/sonar-scanner-*/jre/bin/java
${RUNNER_TEMP}/sonar-scanner-*/scanner/sonar-scanner-*/jre/lib/jspawnhelper

# The engine, on the Java it downloads
${HOME}/.sonar/cache/*/*/*/bin/java
${HOME}/.sonar/cache/*/*/*/lib/jspawnhelper
/usr/bin/uname
/bin/sh
/usr/bin/git
# Refuses to run anywhere but the action's empty run directory: see the traps.
${RUNNER_TEMP}/traps/dotnet

# The analyzers' helpers
/usr/local/bin/node
${HOME}/.sonar/js/node-runtime/node
${RUNNER_TEMP}/sonar-fork-analysis-*/scannerwork/.sonartmp/*/sonar-helm-for-iac-linux-amd64
${RUNNER_TEMP}/sonar-fork-analysis-*/scannerwork/.sonartmp/bridge-dre/bridge
